findings.failure_scenario: While M18.157 is open, last-ci prints 'cold-setup green' for runs over the 600 s budget, so the operator and drive see no overrun signal at all after cp19/cp20 asked for one per run; M18.157's 'three consecutive main runs within the limit' cannot be judged from last-ci, and the by-time branch it does test is now unreachable on main.
findings.recommendation: New row M18.164: last-ci reads the cold-setup step duration (job steps' started/completed, available without the log) or the '::warning title=cold setup over budget' annotation, and prints 'over budget (exempt while M18.157 is open)' instead of green; drop the continue-on-error wording; update M18.161's row text to the post-M18.159 state. Test: a stubbed success job over the limit is not reported green.

findings.evidence: The M18.159 case sets COLD_SETUP_MAX_MS to 1, so each by-status failure it checks is also over the limit; M18.159's EARS asks for 'a stub by-status failure under the limit exits non-zero' while M18.157 is open. M18.154's under-limit case runs with no backlog (no exemption).
findings.failure_scenario: Low: the exemption requires cold.ok, so a status failure cannot be exempted whatever its time; a future refactor that decides by time first (e.g. exempt when the only time problem is present) would not be caught for an under-limit status failure with the row open.
findings.recommendation: Add the under-limit-with-row-todo status case when M18.164 next edits the cold-setup tests; no separate row.
